build.system: When you need a tool, emit a normal tool call for it directly. Do not attempt to call tools from inside the `execute` tool with Python `from ... import ...` syntax - that form is not supported and fails with a syntax error. Never repeat a tool call that has already failed; if a tool errors, change your approach and try a different one.
